qr.title: QR & UPI Safety
qr.subtitle: Understand payment scams before they cost you money.
qr.goldenRule: The one rule that protects you
qr.goldenRuleBody: Scanning a QR code or approving a request is ALWAYS to PAY. You never scan, and never enter a PIN, to RECEIVE money.
qr.scanBody: Upload a photo of a QR code, or paste the text it contains. The image never leaves your device.
qr.decodeFailed: Could not read a QR code in that image. Try a clearer photo.
qr.gameBody: Ten real situations. Choose what you would do.
qr.tipFill: Hold the camera closer so the QR code fills most of the picture.
qr.tipGlare: Avoid glare and shadow — move away from direct light or a screen reflection.
qr.tipFlat: Keep the code flat and straight on, not at an angle.
qr.tipPaste: Still not working? Paste the QR text below instead.

about.title: About CyberSathi
about.whatBody: A community awareness project that helps people recognise cyber-fraud, in English and Tamil. It runs entirely on this computer — no internet connection and no external service is required.
about.privacyBody: Personal details such as OTPs, card numbers, Aadhaar numbers and phone numbers are removed automatically before anything is stored. The link checker never opens the address you give it.
about.limitsBody: This tool gives advice, not a guarantee. A brand-new scam may still be reported as safe. Always verify with your bank using the number printed on your card, and report real incidents to 1930.
about.modelBody: A rule engine with bilingual explanations is combined with machine-learning models trained on this computer. The rules matter because they can explain their reasoning in plain language, and because they catch scam scripts the model has never seen.

disclaimer.full: This is an automated opinion, not a guarantee. Always verify with your bank, or call 1930.

campaign.title: Awareness campaign
campaign.subtitle: Cover these topics before the post-test. This is the part that actually teaches.
campaign.weakNote: This participant answered {{count}} topic(s) poorly in the pre-test. Those are marked as priority and listed first — spend your time there.
campaign.tipDemo: Demonstrate with the app — paste a sample message and let the room predict the verdict first.
campaign.tipAsk: Ask before you tell. "Has anyone here received a message like this?" gets far more attention than a lecture.
campaign.tipShame: Say clearly that doctors, engineers and bank managers have all been caught. Shame is what keeps victims silent.
campaign.tipHelpline: Write 1930 on the board and have the room say it out loud together.
campaign.canProceed: You can start the post-test at any time — ticking every topic is not required.
